Gideon, the first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel records the guard's activity only once in that window: at that point he was **writing trailer numbers on a clipboard**. Nothing else in the channel describes the guard before the kiosks came back. The next guard entry is Mateo's at 11:03 AM, after kiosk 1 was back, saying the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. Your 11:08 update says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

For the postmortem, the guard's own handling of the gap (the clipboard) is the only record in this channel. If you need more detail, such as how long trucks waited, the guard's account would have to come from the people on site.
